key_findings: Review: SpA-associated cytokines (IL-23, IL-17, IL-6, IFN, TNF) signal directly or indirectly through JAK-STAT, so JAK inhibitors act on multiple pathways.
JAK inhibitors (tofacitinib, upadacitinib, filgotinib) improve AS and PsA outcomes with acceptable safety.
